q: 281. Latest finish time in CPM technique is indicated by a

after decompression, the time of an activity invariably exceeds its normal tome
an activity could be decompressed to the maximum extent of its normal time

q: 284. Dummy activities are used to

Dangling must be avoided in a network diagram
Dummy activity consumes no time or resource

q: 286. Due to omission of any part of a project, the duration of project will

q: 292. Batching refers to

weighing accurately, the quantity of each material for a job before mixing
controlling the quantity of each material into each batch
adjusting the water to be added in each batch according to the moisture content of the materials being mixed in the batch

q: 293. Cost of owning an equipment would include
options: cost of depreciation, maintenance and repair and fuel
cost of investment, wages of the crew and fuel
cost of fuel, lubricating oil, investment and depreciation
cost of investment, major repairs and depreciation
explain: Ownership cost covers investment, depreciation and major repairs; fuel, oil and crew are operating costs.

q: 294. Sensitivity analysis is a study of
options: change in output due to change in input
economics of cost and benefits of the project

options: the detailed estimated cost based on detailed design
the several alternatives of the project that have been considered
the soil survey, traffic survey, concept design and approximate cost
the contract documents for inviting tenders
explain: A preliminary report holds surveys, concept design and an approximate cost.

q: 298. A project is

any job involving many people and large money
a work of major importance involving huge men and material
an organised team work to achieve a set task within the time limit

q: 299. Technology is the

study of behaviour men and machines

the movement of heavy vehicles from one place to another
the beginning or the end of a specified job
the progress of work up to centrain limit

a definite route along which one has to proceed
a procedure for preparing the project report
a set of board guidelines stipulated by management

explain: Per the answer key, 4 ft.

the tail of an arrow represents the finish of an activity
arrow bead represents the start of an activity
